svg.text: Concepts for review — pick a direction (or tell me what you like in each).
A T in two halves with one corner dog-eared
Stacked pages that ripple like sound
A 2 from one ribbon, folded at the base
A bookmark you can press play on
One circle: half solid page, half sound
An open book that is also a pause symbol
Quote marks: words read and spoken
A T whose arms are an open book
